newsitem.title: GERMANY: German union offers pay concession for secure jobs.
newsitem.headline: German union offers pay concession for secure jobs.

text.p: German public sector and transport union OeTV, one of the largest in the country, said on Friday it would be prepared to take wage cuts on shortened working hours if employers pledged to generate more jobs.
German unions have traditionally insisted on maintenance of full salary for workers even when companies, in times of a business slump, decide to shorten working hours.

But the OeTV's central wage committee said it was now prepared to negotiate a situation where workers would forego some of their salary in times of shortened work hours if employers agreed to contractual pledges to create more jobs.
The OeTV said it was making the concession in the light of Germany's current unemployment crisis.
